overview.title: MindMap AI by xDev: Think. Draw. Connect.
overview.description: MindMap AI by xDev is a native mind map app for Mac, iPhone and iPad with on-device AI, an infinite canvas and outline view, and nothing collected. Free, with a one-time Pro upgrade.
overview.headline: Think. Draw. Connect.
overview.lead: AI-native visual thinking for Mac, iPhone and iPad. Type, paste or share an idea and shape it into a map you can edit, on an infinite canvas or as an outline. On-device AI helps you expand it, and your maps stay yours.
overview.status: Coming soon to the Mac App Store
overview.note: No account. No ads. No tracking.

map.label: Illustration: a mind map with six branches and one AI suggestion

features.label: Features
features.title: Everything a map needs, nothing in the way.
features.intro: Spend your time thinking, not formatting diagrams. The map stays useful with or without AI.

items.title: Infinite canvas and outline
items.text: Topics lay themselves out automatically on an infinite canvas, or switch to the outline view to write and reorder quickly. Pan, zoom, and undo or redo any step.

items.title: On-device AI
items.text: Apple Intelligence runs on your device to generate a map from a short description, suggest subtopics, brainstorm, suggest tags, summarize a branch and rewrite. Every suggestion is labelled, and you can edit it before you accept it.

items.title: Ask About This Map
items.text: Ask a question about the map you have open and get an answer from the on-device model that cites the topics it used.

items.title: Notes, links and tags
items.text: Add a note to any topic, attach a web link, and tag topics to group related ideas, so a map stays useful as it grows.

items.title: Import and export
items.text: Bring in Markdown and plain text. Export to Markdown, plain text, PNG or PDF, or save a MindMap AI Backup file.

items.title: Search and organize
items.text: Search across all your maps, with or without accents. Keep maps in Favorites and Recent, and restore deleted ones from Recently Deleted.

items.title: Share menu and Shortcuts
items.text: Send text and links to MindMap AI from the Share menu in other apps. Use Shortcuts actions and Spotlight to start a map, add an idea or open a recent map.

items.title: Connect AI apps on your Mac
items.text: Let AI apps such as Claude Code or ChatGPT read your maps through MCP. It is off by default; when you turn it on, each app needs its own token.

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.title: Data Not Collected
privacy.text: MindMap AI has no account, no analytics, no ads and no tracking. xDev runs no servers for it, and your maps are never sent to xDev.
points: AI runs on your device with Apple Intelligence.
Your maps are stored on your device.
AI apps you connect on a Mac can read your maps only after you turn it on.

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.title: Free, with a one-time Pro upgrade.
pricing.intro: Core mind mapping is never locked and there are no ads. No subscription.

plans.name: MindMap AI

items.text: Built for the Mac first, with every command in the menu bar, keyboard shortcuts and multiple windows. Requires macOS 26 or later. AI features need a Mac with Apple silicon and Apple Intelligence.

items.status: Coming soon to the App Store

documents.title: MindMap AI Privacy Policy
documents.description: How MindMap AI by xDev handles your data: nothing is collected, maps stay on your devices and in your own iCloud account, and AI runs on your device.
documents.heading: Privacy Policy
documents.summary: What the app does with your data. In short: nothing is collected.
intro: MindMap AI is built so that your maps stay yours. This policy explains what the app does with your data.

sections.title: What we collect
paragraphs: Nothing. xDev does not run servers for MindMap AI, does not require an account, and does not include analytics, advertising or tracking. Your maps are never sent to xDev.

sections.title: Where your maps are stored
paragraphs: On your device. When iCloud sync is available in the app and you are signed in to iCloud, your maps are also stored in your own private iCloud account, under [Apple’s privacy policy](https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/), so they appear on your other devices. xDev cannot read your iCloud data. To stop syncing, turn off iCloud Sync in MindMap AI ▸ Settings ▸ Data on a Mac, or turn off iCloud for MindMap AI in the Settings app on iPhone and iPad; your maps stay on the device.

sections.title: AI features
paragraphs: AI features use Apple’s on-device model (Apple Intelligence). Your text is processed on your device and is not sent to xDev. Questions and answers in Ask About This Map are saved with the map they are about, stored and synced like the map, and deleted with it or with Clear Chat. On devices without Apple Intelligence, the AI features are not shown.

sections.title: Voice input
paragraphs: When voice input is available, speech is turned into text on your device and is not sent to xDev. The app asks for microphone and speech recognition access the first time you use it.

sections.title: AI apps you connect (Mac)
paragraphs: You can let AI apps on your Mac, such as Claude Code or ChatGPT, read your maps in MindMap AI ▸ Settings ▸ AI Apps. It is off until you turn it on, and each app needs a token you add there. A connected app can read the titles, notes and structure of your maps while MindMap AI is open, and may send what it reads to its own AI provider under that app’s terms and privacy policy; check those before you connect it. MindMap AI does not send this data to xDev. Turn the switch off to stop every app, or revoke one app in the same place.

sections.title: Purchases
paragraphs: Payments are handled by Apple through the App Store. xDev does not receive your payment details.

sections.title: Crash reports from Apple
paragraphs: If you choose to share analytics with app developers in your device settings, Apple may share crash reports and usage statistics with xDev. You control this in your device’s privacy settings.

sections.title: Deleting your data
paragraphs: Delete a map in the app to move it to Recently Deleted. It stays there for 30 days so you can restore it, then it is deleted permanently; Delete Permanently removes it straight away. Deleting the app removes the maps stored on that device. Maps in iCloud can be removed in your device’s iCloud storage settings.

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: The app does not collect data from anyone, including children.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: If this policy changes, we update this page and the date above.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: See [MindMap AI Support](app:support), or email [duy@xdev.asia](mailto:duy@xdev.asia).

sections.title: Price and MindMap AI Pro
paragraphs: The app is free. MindMap AI Pro is an optional one-time in-app purchase that unlocks extra features, described in the app and on the [MindMap AI page](app:).

Apple handles the purchase. The price is shown in the App Store before you buy, and Apple takes the payment. Refunds are requested from Apple under Apple’s policies. Pro is available through Family Sharing. If you reinstall the app or use another device with the same Apple Account, use Restore Purchases in the app’s settings to unlock Pro again.

sections.title: Your content
paragraphs: Your maps and everything you put in them belong to you. We claim no rights to them. They are stored on your devices and, if you use iCloud sync, in your own iCloud account. xDev does not receive them. Keep your own copies of important maps; the app can export them and make backups.

sections.title: AI output
paragraphs: AI features use Apple’s on-device model (Apple Intelligence). AI output can be wrong, incomplete or out of date. Review it before you rely on it or share it. You decide what to accept, and you are responsible for how you use the result.

sections.title: Acceptable use
paragraphs: Use the app only in lawful ways. Do not use it to break the law or to violate the rights of others, and do not try to get around its in-app purchase or security protections.

sections.title: AI apps you connect (Mac)
paragraphs: On a Mac you can let other AI apps, such as Claude Code or ChatGPT, read your maps. Those apps are third-party services. They are not provided by xDev, and your use of them is governed by their own terms and privacy policies. xDev is not responsible for what they do with the content they read.

sections.title: No warranty
paragraphs: To the extent the law allows, the app is provided “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind. We do not promise that the app is free of errors or always available. Some places do not allow these exclusions, so they may not apply to you.

Nothing in these terms limits liability that the law does not allow to be limited.

documents.title: MindMap AI Support
documents.description: Get help with MindMap AI by xDev: how to contact us, where your maps are stored, why AI features may be hidden, and how to delete your data.
documents.heading: Support
documents.summary: Contact us and find answers to common questions.

paragraphs: **Contact us:** [duy@xdev.asia](mailto:duy@xdev.asia). Please tell us your device, its system version and the app version (Settings ▸ About in the app). Do not send map content unless you want us to see it.

sections.title: Where are my maps?
paragraphs: On your device. MindMap AI has no account and no xDev servers. See the [privacy policy](app:privacy).

sections.title: Why don’t I see AI features?
paragraphs: AI features need Apple Intelligence, which runs on the device. They appear only on devices that support Apple Intelligence, with Apple Intelligence turned on in system settings, and in a language it supports. On other devices the AI features are hidden; everything else works.

sections.title: The app says it can’t open my maps.
paragraphs: Quit and reopen the app. If the message comes back, [contact us](#contact) and mention that message; do not delete the app, because deleting it removes the maps stored on the device.

sections.title: How do I delete my data?
paragraphs: Delete maps in the app; they wait in Recently Deleted for 30 days, or use Delete Permanently there to remove them now. Deleting the app removes the maps stored on that device.
